papers.title: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems
papers.desc: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent.

papers.title: SWE-Bench Pro Verified: A Reliable Benchmark for Software Engineering Agents
papers.desc: SWE-Bench Pro has emerged as a standard benchmark for evaluating software engineering agents on challenging repository-level tasks.

papers.title: SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators
papers.desc: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions.

papers.title: Train Smarter, Not Harder: Switching Signal-Guided Training in Active Learning
papers.desc: Training strategy, namely whether to retrain from scratch or fine-tune from the previous checkpoint, is an overlooked decision variable in active learning.

papers.title: OracleZoom: On-Policy Self-Distillation Inspired Reference-Constrained Recursive Image Super Resolution
papers.desc: Recursive Super-Resolution (SR) extends fixed-scale SR to extreme magnification by repeatedly feeding predictions back into the same model, analogous to zooming an image repeatedly.

papers.title: Why Is Video Still So Expensive? A Survey of Inference-Efficiency Mechanisms in Video and Audiovisual LLMs
papers.desc: Video understanding has rapidly evolved toward video large language models (VideoLLMs): systems that couple video representations with pretrained large language models and condition generation on a textual prompt.

papers.title: A Three-Layer Caching Architecture for Low-Latency LLM Web Search on Commodity CPU Hardware
papers.desc: AI-powered search products such as ChatGPT search, Google's AI Overviews, and Perplexity provide LLM-synthesized answers grounded in live web results.

papers.title: StochBench: A Domain-Specific Benchmark for Stochastic Processes in Lean
papers.desc: Leading benchmarks for formal theorem proving with large language models are small collections drawn from competition math, such as the IMO and Putnam, that poorly represent field-specific applications.

papers.title: SchemeArena: Factorized Stress Testing of Scheming in LLM Agents
papers.desc: We study scheming in LLM agents, in which agents covertly pursue misaligned goals.

papers.title: From Reweighting to Rewriting: Unlocking the Intervention Effects of Influential Samples in Training Data Attribution
papers.desc: Training data attribution (TDA) aims to identify training examples that shape model behavior, but its intervention value depends on both which examples are selected and how they are modified.

papers.title: The Semantic Bottleneck: Leveraging Semantic Representations for Non-Invasive Speech Decoding
papers.desc: Non-invasive speech decoding remains constrained by the low signal-to-noise ratio of neural recordings, which makes fine-grained reconstruction of phonemes or individual words difficult.

papers.title: PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving
papers.desc: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge.

papers.title: Reference-Based Bias Detection in LLMs via Relative Representations of Hidden States
papers.desc: Existing bias auditing methods typically rely on model outputs, requiring costly benchmarks or judge models and potentially missing internal shifts that never appear in generated text.

papers.title: DF26: We Cannot Tell Fake From Real Anymore
papers.desc: We introduce DF26, a novel benchmark for detecting AI-generated videos containing fully synthetic clips produced by recent text-to-video and image-to-video models.

papers.title: The Price of Sparsity: Sufficient Conditions for Sparse Recovery using Sparse and Sparsified Measurements
papers.desc: We consider the problem of support recovery for sparse binary signals from noisy linear measurements.
